summary: The Skip/Pause/Stop buttons are gone from the now-playing reply. Music is controlled by asking Nora, or by a slash command.
details: The now-playing panel was a third control surface for verbs the slash commands already own. Each click was a Discord interaction carrying a ~3 second acknowledgement deadline, over a control plane whose round-trips routinely outlast it — the defer-first corrections of 2026-09-16 were that deadline biting three separate handlers in one view.
Nothing is lost: skip, pause, resume and stop are all reachable by asking Nora in the room, and all have slash commands.
The queue paginator on /music queue is untouched — it is navigation, not control, and has no command equivalent.
A test pins the absence structurally rather than by name: any new view class in the music command module fails it, so re-adding controls has to be deliberate.
